newsitem.title: USA: AT&T, BCE unit decline comment on CFO rumors.
newsitem.headline: AT&T, BCE unit decline comment on CFO rumors.

text.p: AT&T Corp declined to comment Monday on reports that it is close to hiring senior Bell Canada executive Dan Somers as its chief financial officer.
"We are not commenting nor would we speculate on when an announcement may occur," an AT&T spokeswoman said.
Bell Canada International, a subsidiary of Montreal-based BCE Inc, also said it had no comment on the reports.

Somers, the chairman and chief executive of Bell Canada's British unit Bell Cablemedia Plc, would succeed Richard Miller. Miller announced earlier this year he planned to leave AT&T to pursue other interests.
Citing people familiar with AT&T's plans, the Wall Street Journal said Monday that AT&T could make an announcement regarding Somers this week.
